Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, follow along as Mark Peterson sets out on his second attempt in British Columbia for a Stone Sheep with his Gunwerks muzzleloader. After dealing with terrible weather and not many sheep encounters on his first hunt, Mark is eager to fill his tag this time around. Traveling to some of the best areas for sheep, Mark and the crew have a spectacular week of sheep encounters along with multiple close calls that will tear you down and drive you crazy!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Another great hunt this week with Intrepid Care. We have the chance to hang out with some Veterans from all over the country. We gather to tell stories, build relationships, and just enjoy the great outdoors. This trip is action packed and the guys are chasing South Texas hogs from the ground.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: hunting_land_man
programme.desc: It’s Caleb’s turn to hunt and Slade gets behind the camera. They encounter their target buck, but end up getting a shot at a different buck, and it’s a big boy.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Ship Shape TV

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and part of the old Trained Assassins Crew, Luke Mitchell (producer) and Ryan Wascom (host), head out to Colorado to chase bugling elk with their bows. Also joining the crew is one of Slade’s real estate clients and his son. Part of the deal when this client worked with Slade was that Slade lined them up an elk hunt the following fall. It is an amazing week at camp with five arrows being sent down range and multiple elk hitting the dirt. You do not want to miss this one.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are back in Missouri on our new farm that we’ve recently purchased. We developed our last farm, and did a 1031 tax free exchange to buy this farm so we can develop and sell it later on. This is the first time we’ve seen the property, so we are finding out what we are going to do with it and how we are going to lay it out. Once we get that figured out, we go into the dirty work of planting, moving box stands, and making sure everything is good for hunting season. Fast forward and we have two amazing hunts where both Ryan and myself take awesome bucks with our bows. This one has it all! Do not miss it!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are super busy juggling the turkey season opener, but we also have our real estate convention in Gulf Shores Alabama, multiple listing videos to complete, and property showings. It happens every year to us, spring kicks off and people want to have properties of their own knowing dog gone well it’s the most wonderful time of the year. TURKEY SEASON! It’s a jam up of a week. You’re not going to want to miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are smacking turkeys and making mid-term investments. 1031 Tax money is the number one way to build your land portfolio and create a place for your family to enjoy. Follow along as we turn a old beat up piece of dirt and turn it into the ultimate place ground for a hunter such as myself. From habitat to harvest we have been on fire.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: WE join Bobby Falkenberg as he joins Bret Ferguson from Double T Outfitters. Bobby is an avid outdoorsman, judge, and father of 5. Bret manages 30,000 acres in Ozona TX, the knowledge he has of every inch of this amazing low fence ranch is remarkable. Bobby has an action packed 2 day hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our college chapters. Hudson has been a long time member of TTHA as well as serving with the Texas A&M Chapter. We have a great time at G2 in pursuit of Axis deer.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re back with Double T Outfitters for this episode of Storytellers, filmed at the beautiful Las Lagunas Ranch in South Texas! - This hunt was one to remember as we spent time with the Price family, including Logan—our Show Your Skull Showdown winner from last season! From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate’s wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Honeymoon
programme.desc: On her birthday, Summer is publicly humiliated when her fiancé, Chance, and her best friend, Portia, reveal their affair. Seeking revenge, she sabotages their honeymoon with the help of her friend Danisha. A deadly game of cat-and-mouse ensues, with betrayal, violence, and unexpected twists. Ultimately, Summer must confront the consequences of her actions as she fights for her life and seeks justice.

programme.title: Judge Knott
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Threaded Lies
programme.desc: When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything. As paranoia sets in, Dante must confront the lies he’s built his success on before they destroy him.

programme.title: All the Love
programme.desc: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can’t fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust. Will she find love or suffer the same mysterious fate as her birth parents?

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

This semifinal match features top senior pros Nathalie Bagby and Beth Bellamy facing Jennifer Dawson and Bonnie Williams in a high-stakes contest. Expert commentary highlights key strategies, player strengths, and match dynamics including powerful serves from Ava Welsher, tactical lobs, and intense court positioning. We also recap the Vanta Blackwater Team Cup in the Cayman Islands, share Sonny's weekly coaching tip, and meet DUPR ambassador Heather Kim.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from The Picklr in Noblesville, this NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 matchup features a critical battle between the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Purdue University. With eight national bids and $5,000 in prize money on the line, the stakes are high as the 16th-seeded Purdue takes on the 17th-seeded Wisconsin in a best-of-seven format.The match kicks off with Gender Doubles, where Wisconsin’s duo of Noah and Sarah Sowinski showcase dominant net play and quick hands against Purdue’s Caleb Yang and Trevor Ju. Watch for standout moments, including an incredible Ernie from Wisconsin and strategic adjustments in the Mixed Doubles games involving Colton Thielman and Elena Schlichte.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The atmosphere is electric as the top-seeded Indiana Hoosiers clash with the relentless Utah Valley Wolverines in a high-stakes quarterfinal showdown. With a boisterous Hoosier crowd fueling every point, UVU’s powerhouse duo must find a way to silence the stands and keep their hunt for a first national title alive. Witness explosive "howitzer" drives and tactical brilliance as these elite programs trade blows in a must-win battle for a spot in the Final Four.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's Semi-Final Time on Day 9 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL)! This highly anticipated clash pits the Bengaluru Jawans, who finished top of the table (number one seed), against the Hyderabad Superstars, who narrowly snuck into the semi-finals (number four seed) after winning two matches the previous night. This is a classic 1 vs. 4 match-up, with the winner stamping their ticket to Championship Sunday.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the tactical intensity of the World Pickleball League as the Rajasthan Titans look to mount a comeback against the surging Hyderabad Superstars. programme.title: VANTA Blackwater Team Cup

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere of the second "South Indian derby" in World Pickleball League Season 2 as the undefeated table-toppers, Chennai Super Champs, face off against the formidable Hyderabad Superstars. The drama unfolds at Mumbai's Jio World Garden with high-velocity matches, including a premier showdown between unbeaten singles stars Rika Fujiwara and Shawn Mendes. Every rally is a tactical masterclass, featuring the "beast from the East" Lee Hwang Nam in a high-stakes mixed doubles battle against Caitlin Hart and Louis Laville. From "sensational lobs" to the strategic intensity of men's singles, this tie showcases the pinnacle of professional pickleball as both teams fight for dominance on the leaderboard.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.desc: Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.title: Phosfate

programme.desc: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Cauliflower and broccoli, differently. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet prepares orecchiette with broccoli pesto and a cauliflower tabbouleh. Discovery of the day: recycled Glask glasses, or how to create beautiful glasses from discarded bottles.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Philippe Hurel, manufacturing high quality furniture since 1911. "L'habit ne fait pas le moine" (the clothes don't make the man): a very French expression from... Monaco. In Milly-la-Forêt we discover the work of French artist Jean Cocteau. A timeless essential for the winter wardrobe: how to wear a cable sweater.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.desc: A comedian and actor, Jonathan Lambert has a passion for art, and is the author of a photo-novel, "Qui a volé mes jambes?" (Who stole my legs?), a tribute to the surrealist painter Pierre Molinier. He is also curator of the exhibition "A Hundred Years of Chess", presented at the Perrotin Gallery in Paris. Pauline Guerrier is a cosmopolitan and well-travelled artist. Her sculptures and tapestries are inspired by her encounters with craftspeople from Benin to India. Claire Tabouret's drawings at the Grand Palais and her stained-glass windows at Notre-Dame are in the Vizorek'xpert chronicle. A look back at the theft of a Rembrandt, with Reza Pounewatchy.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: The Musée des Beaux-Arts du Périgord offers a rich and varied selection of works. In his studio, Tuan Tran combines the finesse of glass with the brutality of concrete. At Schiaparelli, masculine and feminine are confidently combined. Dive behind the scenes of D'Offard wallpaper production.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: We take a closer look during Paris fashion week at the new trends at Dior, Weinsento, Paco Rabanne, Saint Laurent, Balmain and Akris. Everything you need to know about some major designers' cruise collections. Saint Chaffray workshop is in charge of designing decors for spectacular fashion shows.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Nature as an answer for tomorrow
programme.desc: Opposite the Grand-Leez reed bed, Adrien meets up with Nathalie Fonder, an agronomist. An opportunity to reflect on the challenges and solutions for a greener future. Then a musical encounter with Grandgeorge, ambassador of green living.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Cindy, Roland, Seni and Christian share a common passion, free-diving in the lakes of Romandy. Whether in search of the mysteries of the deep, or the simple pleasure of being embraced by the water, exploring the depths also reveals their inner nature.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: Clémence d'Ennery unveils her collection of Asian works in a Paris hotel. Using porcelain petals, Juliette Clovis opens up a luminous, dreamlike world. At Rabanne, we push the boundaries of women's dressing with bold materials. Immerse yourself in the studio of artist Marion Mezenge.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Painter and creator of unique mural decors, the artist Solène Eloy is inspired by the fresco painting technique. Everything you need to know about the design of the first Air Max. In Normandy, stopover at Villedieu-les-Poêles, in the heart of L'Atelier du cuivre. The chic way to wear jogging bottoms.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: Nature, a path to well-being
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, plants have also been used as remedies. With Nolwenn Lécuyer, a forest therapy guide, Adrien takes part in a wild dawn. A chance to pamper yourself in the heart of nature and enjoy a musical interlude with the voice of Saule.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Amongst the vines of Lavaux, the World Tracassets Championships is a spring carnival where anything goes. The tracassets, small three-wheeled tractors, were built in the 1950s to work the steep slopes of the vineyards. To compete in the famous race, each has been meticulously customised.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: We're off to the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Tours! In the heart of Paris, mosaic artist Luigi La Ferla builds and deconstructs his works. With Mame Kurogouchi, shape is sculpted from the body itself. Painter Camille Viry brings her landscapes to life using traditional decorative painting techniques.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: The Marathon de la Mode Durable: a runway show designed to showcase the creativity of the IFA Paris students. Focus on seersucker, a fabric we know so well but without realising it. Moirans en Montagne makes high quality wooden toys. How to wear a bathrobe.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026
programme.desc: Welcome to very Francophile Albania, where the French language has left its mark on history. First stop, Korça, the cradle of Albanian Francophonie, home to the French military cemetery and the first French high school founded in the Balkans. Then on to Gjirokastër, the stone city, and Berat, the city of a thousand windows.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Mireille Keïta builds bridges between the country that offered her a home, Switzerland, and her native Africa. She is the organiser of the Yelen Africa Festival in Baulmes, showcasing the advantages of cultural mixity. The profits are then used to improve people's lives in several villages in Mali.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: In Boulogne-Billancourt, visit the Musée des Années 30. Stefania Di Petrillo explores the emotional dimensions of design. Artistic director Pieter Mulier is following in the footsteps of the founder of the Alaïa fashion house: sophistication at its best. The organic forms of an omnipresent nature are embodied in the creations of cabinetmaker Maxime Goléo.

programme.title: #VF S09
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy, lifestyle... Discover the world of French chic!

programme.title: TENDANCE XXI S10
programme.desc: Leather is his preferred means of expression, we meet flamboyant designer Jean-Claude Jitrois. Nylon revolutionised the textile industry: but where did its name come from? Near Agde, the small town of Pezenas is home to stone carvers, cabinet-makers, artisan metalworkers, glass-makers... Minimalist and practical, how to wear a boob tube.

programme.title: L'ART ET LA MATIERE-S09
programme.desc: Fashion, crafts, design, art of living... The 'French touch' at its best.

programme.title: DESTINATION FRANCOPHONIE 2025-2026
programme.desc: The Pyramid, Vila 31, the College of Europe... Discover Tirana, the vibrant Albanian capital, in the company of Thomas Frasheri. Dive into the festive atmosphere of the Albanian Night, then enjoy an exceptional meeting with Edi Rama, the very Francophile Prime Minister. Final stop, Shkodër, the cycling capital, and its fascinating Marubi museum.

programme.title: CHIC EN VF S10
programme.desc: Fashion, design, gastronomy and art de vivre... Lifestyle experts chat with Katherina Marx, an enthusiastic ambassador for French style.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: Max Brumberg, flute designer, has set himself a challenge: that of resurrecting the aulos, an instrument that has lain forgotten for 2,000 years. Resembling a recorder, the aulos produces an enchanting, magical note. In classical times, it was said to hypnotise and bewitch the listening crowds.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years after Ferdy Villiers committed suicide at the family home of Draycott Hall, the extended Villiers family gather together to celebrate Christmas. programme.desc: While Chief Bill Gillespie is out of town, a series of mysterious fires break out in town.

programme.desc: When a human leg bone is discovered, Sparta police question an eccentric old lady named known as the Pig Lady.

programme.desc: When a young beauty queen contestant commits suicide, Gillespie and Virgil make a startling discovery.

programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs are desperate to halt the spread of crack cocaine among the young people of their town.

programme.desc: While hitchhiking his way to Sparta, a Vietnamese teenager witnesses a store robbery that turns into a murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An ex-prizefighter tries to blackmail his old boss, a mafia kingpin in Detroit.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A mild-mannered Sparta businessman shoots his wife and her lover and then flees with his daughter.

programme.desc: A friend of Bubba's is framed for theft and kills himself. Only his young son knows the truth.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Someone mysteriously leaves a baby on Lieutenant Bubba Skinner's doorstep.

programme.desc: A conservative minister is murdered while trying to close down a traveling bordello operating near his church.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: After an employee of the high school is run off the road by the driver of a semi-truck, resulting in death.

programme.desc: After her involvement in a crime committed in Philadelphia, Regina, an old friend of Althea's runs to Sparta.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.
